$comment: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE for table identity. Edit this file, then run `node packages/contracts/scripts/generate.mjs` to regenerate the Dart and TypeScript outputs. Never edit the generated files.
name: table-identity

canonicalTableId.$comment: The immutable cross-system identity of one physical table. It is an RFC 4122 UUID generated once by an offline-capable POS and never derived from floor, number, label, website mapping, or geometry.

tableRef.$comment: A lossless compatibility reference: floor key and table number joined by a separator. It is not the canonical physical-table identity. Floor keys never contain the separator, so the FIRST occurrence splits the two halves and any later ones belong to the table number.

legacyTableCode.$comment: The transitional integer encoding. It can only represent two floors and is bounded by the first floor's maximum, because a first-floor number above that maximum would decode as a second-floor table. It is NOT the long-term table identity — tableRef is. Floors are listed lowest offset first.

floors.$comment: Bounded: table 11 would encode to 11, which decodes as second floor table 1.
Unbounded upward: nothing above it to collide with.
